transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
My head feels foggy and I can’t focus long enough to figure out my bills or make decisions about work anymore. It's just gotten so hard to think straight lately.

Along with the brain fog, have you been feeling depressed most of the day or constantly worried for at least the past two weeks? Also, did these thinking problems start after a major stressor or after any new medical illness, injury, or medication change?

Yeah, most days I feel this heavy, empty sadness, which has been coming and going for several months but got way worse this past month. It all started getting really bad after my part-time maintenance hours got cut and I fell behind on rent, not because of any medical problems or new medicines.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in almost everything, and have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living or of hurting yourself? If yes, when did that start?

I’ve completely lost interest in walking by the lake or building my model cars, and now I just lie on the couch staring at the TV. I do feel like there's no point to anything lately, but I don't have any thoughts of hurting myself. This feeling has been coming and going for several months, but it got much worse this past month.

Since this got worse, have you had other depression symptoms like major changes in sleep or appetite, feeling slowed down or unable to move, or strong guilt/worthlessness nearly every day? Or does it feel more like a reaction to the rent and work stress without those severe symptoms?

It's definitely much more than just stress—I can barely force down one sandwich a day and wake up at 3 or 4 AM tossing and turning over bills. I feel like I'm constantly moving underwater just to do simple chores, and I keep telling myself I'm a lazy, useless screwup who brought this all on myself.
When you’re feeling at your worst, have you heard or seen things other people don’t, or felt certain that you’re guilty, ruined, or being punished in a way others say isn’t true?

No, I've never heard or seen things that aren't really there. I don't feel like I'm being punished in some strange way, though I do just feel like a total failure and a screwup because of my own mistakes.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient describes a current major depressive episode with severe symptom burden: persistent depressed mood, marked anhedonia, insomnia with early morning awakening, markedly reduced appetite, psychomotor slowing, impaired concentration/indecisiveness, and excessive worthlessness/guilt, worsening over the past month and causing clear functional impairment. Psychotic symptoms were explicitly denied. Although symptoms worsened after financial stress, the syndrome exceeds a normal stress reaction in severity and breadth, supporting a severe depressive episode without psychotic symptoms.
